uutiset.s: Deutsche Boerse AG’s €5.3 billion ($5.8 billion) deal for Allfunds Group Plc has won European Union unconditional approval, paving the way for the largest acquisition in the German exchange operator’s history.

uutiset.s: Turkey’s Vice President Cevdet Yilmaz said payments from liquidated investment funds will be based on the market price of assets they carry, signaling that many small investors may not recover their full principal.

uutiset.t: JSE Courts Dangote Refinery Secondary Listing in Expansion Push
uutiset.s: Africa’s biggest stock exchange is working with Dangote Group to pave the way for a potential secondary listing of its giant oil refinery in Johannesburg, an outcome the bourse’s chief said would be the ideal next step after its landmark Nigerian initial public offering.

uutiset.t: Russia Extends Jet Fuel Export Ban to March on Refinery Attacks
uutiset.s: Russia extended a ban on most jet fuel exports by four months through March to keep its domestic market supplied as Ukraine continues to attack the country’s refineries.

uutiset.s: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.
